title: 研究背景与场景

title: 水下导航挑战
takeaway: GPS-denied underwater operation causes dead-reckoning drift
bullets: No direct GPS during submerged phases
Frontseat internal estimate accumulates position error
Fuse DVL, AHRS, and CTD observations

title: 目标与贡献
takeaway: DVL-Odo plus BSD/BMC improves onboard navigation
bullets: Run improved navigation on Raspberry Pi 4 BSD
Provide DVL-Odo odometry and BMC waypoint correction
Compare frontseat and BMC-guided error
Validate in tropical and Arctic trials

title: 系统总体架构
takeaway: ROS sensors -> BSD navigation -> mission control -> frontseat/flight computer
bullets: Drivers publish CTD, DVL, AHRS, MSIS and frontseat topics
BSD backseat navigation estimates state
Mission controller publishes directives

title: DVL-Odo 导航流程
takeaway: DVL velocity and attitude form underwater odometry
bullets: DVL measures relative velocity
AHRS supplies attitude and heading
BSD fuses observations for real-time state
Combined navigation and sonar draw <15 W

title: BMC 航点修正：carrot following
takeaway: BMC feeds updated waypoints to the frontseat
bullets: Frontseat sequences mission normally
BMC updates waypoints from backseat estimate
Abort triggers under-ice surfacing behavior

title: 实验平台与传感器
takeaway: BSD integrates CTD, DVL, AHRS and MSIS
bullets: Raspberry Pi 4 backseat computer (BSD)
Sea-Bird CTD; Teledyne RDI Pathfinder 600-kHz DVL
Sparton M2 AHRS; 700-kHz Tritech MSIS

title: Puerto Rico 海底测绘
takeaway: DVL/MSIS bathymetry compared with NOAA LiDAR

title: 北极冰下同步测绘
takeaway: DVL maps seafloor while MSIS identifies surface ice
bullets: Beaufort Sea marginal ice zone northeast of Prudhoe Bay
MSIS uses +/-10 deg upward sweep; track about 1.3 km
Compare with IBCAO 4.2.13 (200 m grid)

title: 误差与测绘精度
takeaway: BMC 11% average position error versus 44% frontseat
bullets: BMC-guided missions: 11% of distance travelled
Frontseat internal estimate: 44%
Fig. 8 top delta mean/median/std: 0.29 / 0.35 / 0.78

title: 结果讨论与局限
bullets: Arctic ocean-floor estimate differs from IBCAO by approximately 3 m
Surface-vessel depth-sounder logs used for verification

Coverage and sensor availability remain operational concerns

title: 对数字孪生的启示
takeaway: Connect BSD state, DVL-Odo track, and sonar observations into a replayable loop
bullets: Record navigation state, waypoints, and timestamps

Use error metrics to trigger waypoint update or abort
<15 W budget supports long-duration deployment
